title: Brand-spec card
description: The gradeable subset of brand_guideline_corpus.schema.json — a brand's strategy plus its typed, evidence-linked primitives, flattened into one self-contained object. Consumed by bin/brand-spec-check.py (the B1 well-formedness contract). The semantic gates (UNTRACED provenance, LOW_CONFIDENCE, COLLAPSED_TRUTH, CONTRAST_FAIL, GENERIC_IDEA, INCOMPLETE) are NOT expressible here — they live in the bin and are reported with domain-meaningful kinds. This schema is the declarative contract; validate a card against it with type-decomposer's instance-check.py or any JSON-Schema tool.

brand_idea.description: The central idea (A1). GENERIC_IDEA fails if it is only interchangeable adjectives/filler.

meaning_chain.description: idea -> voice -> mark -> color -> type -> ... (A2); < 4 links warns.

domains.description: Presence map — a key present marks that rubric domain claimed-covered (B4).

surfaces.description: Where the brand lives (B4); empty = INCOMPLETE.

confidence.description: Operational trust band: >=0.90 explicit, >=0.75 strong, >=0.50 review-required, <0.50 do-not-use. A boolean is NOT a valid confidence.

truth.description: The three truths, never collapsed. A value outside this set is COLLAPSED_TRUTH (a B2 gate fail in the bin).

value.description: A token with a value but no role+meaning is a BARE_TOKEN (advisory).

review.description: Marks a low-confidence inference as human-review-flagged.

domain.description: The six rubric domains, or any full-corpus brand_domain value (normalized: logo->mark, typography->type, the 11 expression sub-domains->expression).

severity.description: RFC-2119 (the corpus enum): must = hard rule, should = strong default, may = flexible range.

context.description: Where the rule applies / does not (B5 retrievability).

description.description: What it teaches, not just what it looks like.

size.description: Drives the WCAG AA floor (normal 4.5, large 3.0).
